description:
Andrew Morgan LLC (AM) is a fast-growing Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). We are currently seeking a junior OneStream AI Engineer to build AI-enabled planning, forecasting and automation capabilities on the OneStream platform for federal clients. The role sits within Andrew Morgan’s OneStream Center of Excellence and would be suitable for someone with at least two years of experience who wants to grow at the intersection of AI and federal financial management.

 About the OneStream Center of Excellence 

 Andrew Morgan’s OneStream Center of Excellence delivers OneStream implementations for federal clients, including the Department of War and various Federal Civilian Agencies. The practice supports budget formulation and execution, financial reporting, financial close and workforce planning under frameworks such as PPBE and OMB Circular A-11, and integrates OneStream with source systems such as SAP S/4HANA, Momentum, Oracle etc.

 RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 The engineer will build, test and support AI capabilities inside OneStream environments, working under the direction of senior architects in the Center of Excellence.

 
 Forecasting and machine learning: Configure and tune predictive forecasts using OneStream’s SensibleAI Forecast (formerly Sensible ML), including data preparation, feature and driver selection, model evaluation and accuracy reporting.

 AI solution development: Build AI-enabled workflows with SensibleAI Studio and its Routines, such as anomaly detection, variance summarization and natural-language data queries, and help configure SensibleAI Agents for finance users.

 OneStream development: Write and maintain business rules (VB.NET or C#), dashboards, cube views and data integrations that feed and consume AI outputs.

 Data engineering: Prepare and validate financial and operational data from source systems such as SAP S/4HANA, including data quality checks and transformation logic.

 Federal budget use cases: Apply AI to budget formulation, execution and reporting needs, such as spend forecasting, financial close, execution variance analysis and narrative commentary for PPBE and OMB Circular A-11 deliverables.

 Governance and documentation: Document models, assumptions and results so that AI outputs are transparent, explainable and auditable for federal stakeholders.

 Client support: Join requirements sessions, demos and user training, and translate client questions into technical tasks.

 Practice building: Contribute reusable accelerators, templates and lessons learned to the Center of Excellence.

 
 REQUIREMENTS: 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, information systems, engineering, mathematics, finance or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 A minimum of 2 years of professional experience in software development, data engineering, data science or enterprise application implementation.

 Working knowledge of Python and SQL, and experience with at least one object-oriented language such as C# or VB.NET.

 Hands-on exposure to machine learning or statistical forecasting, such as time-series models, regression or anomaly detection.

 Familiarity with generative AI concepts, such as large language models, prompt design and retrieval-augmented generation.

 Comfort working with financial or operational data, including data cleansing, validation and reconciliation.

 Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical results to finance users.

 U.S. citizenship and eligibility for a federal security clearance or public trust are expected for this role.

 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 

 OneStream experience is a strong plus but not required; candidates with solid AI and data skills who are eager to learn the platform are encouraged to apply.

 
 Hands-on OneStream experience, such as business rules, cube views, dashboards, workflow or data integration.

 OneStream certification (OCA/OCP) or OneStream training courses (Mirco Certifications)

 Exposure to OneStream’s SensibleAI portfolio (Forecast, Studio or Agents).

 Experience with other corporate performance management or ERP platforms, such as SAP, Oracle EPM/Hyperion or Anaplan.

 Understanding of federal financial management, including PPBE, appropriations, OMB Circular A-11 or DoW financial systems.

 Prior work on federal or DoW contracts.

 Experience with Azure, AWS or other cloud ML services, and with tools such as pandas, scikit-learn or Jupyter.

 An active security clearance.

 
 SALARY: 

 Base Salary: $90,000 - $130,000

 Salary is commensurate with both location and experience.

 THE AM EMPLOYEE WILL DISPLAY… 

 
 Attention to Detail: Produce high-quality deliverables and outputs that align with contract outcomes.

 Self-Sufficiency: Execute tasks independently, seeking client assistance only after internal resources are exhausted, ensuring requests align with contract goals.

 Teamwork: Collaborate effectively with team members, including AMC resources, subcontractors, and government stakeholders.

 Communication/Engagement: Maintain professional conduct in meetings and written communication, participating actively with cameras on.

 Responsiveness: Stay engaged, communicate promptly, and ensure deadlines are consistently met.

 
 ABOUT ANDREW MORGAN… 

 Andrew Morgan LLC, founded in 2017 and headquartered in Alexandria, VA, is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). We specialize in delivering high-quality consulting services to both federal and commercial clients, offering expertise in Strategy and Management Consulting, Technology & Architecture Services, and Industry & Mission Analytics Solutions. Our distinguished clientele includes the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA), the Department of Defense (DoD), and the United Stated Army Corps of Engineers (USACE). We are committed to providing innovative solutions and exceptional service to support our clients' missions and objectives. 

 BENEFITS: 

 
 15 days of Paid Time Off + 11 Paid Federal Holidays

 401K Program (up to 4% employer matching)

 Three Gold Healthcare Options (with 75%-90% employer-paid premiums)

 Flexible Spending Account / Dependent Care Assistance Program

 Employer-Paid Short Term Disability Insurance 

 Employer-Paid Long Term Disability Insurance 

 Employer-Paid Life Insurance 

 Professional Training and Development

 Corporate Team Building Events

 And MORE!

 
 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER: 

 Andrew Morgan does not discriminate in employment opportunities, terms and conditions of employment, or practices. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, age, gender, religious or political beliefs, national origin or heritage, disability, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any characteristic protected by law. ​
